destinations.name: Amber Fort (Amer Fort)
destinations.weather: Hot summers (35-45°C), pleasant winters (8-28°C), monsoon moderate

budget.includes: Entry (₹100 Indians/₹500 foreigners), elephant ride optional (₹400-1000), audio guide, transport, meals for 1 day

destinations.difficultyNotes: Uphill walk or elephant ride to entrance; fort has stairs
destinations.bestTime: Morning (8-10 AM) to avoid crowds and heat
destinations.description: 16th-century Rajput fort built by Raja Man Singh I; expanded by Sawai Jai Singh II. Features Diwan-e-Aam, Diwan-e-Khas, Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace), Sukh Niwas, and panoramic Aravalli views. UNESCO World Heritage Site (Hill Forts of Rajasthan, 2013). Elephant rides available from base.
destinations.safety: Beware of touts for elephant rides; use authorized operators only; watch steps

access.specialAccess: Open 8 AM-5:30 PM daily; composite ticket available

destinations.seasonalStatus: Year-round

destinations.name: City Palace
destinations.weather: Hot summers (35-45°C), pleasant winters (8-28°C), monsoon moderate

budget.includes: Entry (₹300 Indians/₹1000 foreigners for museum), Chandra Mahal extra, transport, meals for 1 day

destinations.difficultyNotes: Palace grounds accessible; museum has stairs
destinations.bestTime: Morning (9:30-11 AM) or night visit (7-7:30 PM)
destinations.description: 18th-century royal residence built by Sawai Jai Singh II; still home to Jaipur royal family. Features Mubarak Mahal, Chandra Mahal, Diwan-e-Khas, museums with royal costumes, weapons, manuscripts. Blend of Rajasthani and Mughal architecture in heart of Pink City.
destinations.safety: Very safe; no photography in some museum areas

access.specialAccess: Open 9:30 AM-6:30 PM (closed Holi); night visits 7-7:30 PM

destinations.seasonalStatus: Year-round

destinations.name: Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds)
destinations.weather: Hot summers (35-45°C), pleasant winters (8-28°C), monsoon moderate

budget.includes: Entry (₹50 Indians/₹200 foreigners), transport, meals for 1 day

destinations.difficultyNotes: Five-story building with ramps; no elevator
destinations.bestTime: Sunrise (9-10 AM) for best light and fewer crowds
destinations.description: 1799 five-story palace built by Maharaja Sawai Pratap Singh; designed by Lal Chand Ustad. Features 953 jharokhas (windows) creating honeycomb cooling effect. Enabled royal ladies to observe street festivals while maintaining purdah. Icon of Rajput architecture and UNESCO World Heritage Site (2019).
destinations.safety: Very safe; watch steps on narrow passages

access.specialAccess: Open 9 AM-4:30 PM daily

destinations.seasonalStatus: Year-round

destinations.name: Jantar Mantar
destinations.weather: Hot summers (35-45°C), pleasant winters (8-28°C), monsoon moderate

budget.includes: Entry (₹50 Indians/₹200 foreigners), audio guide, transport, meals for 1 day

destinations.difficultyNotes: Fully accessible; walking on stone instruments
destinations.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site (2010); largest of five astronomical observatories built by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II (1728-1734). Features 19 monumental masonry instruments including Samrat Yantra (world's largest sundial), Jai Prakash, Ram Yantra. Still accurate to predict time and track celestial bodies.
destinations.safety: Very safe; do not climb on instruments

access.specialAccess: Open 9 AM-7 PM daily (last entry 6:30 PM)
